warnings: Violating daily or maximum drawdown limits will result in immediate account termination.

faqs.question: How do payouts work at Funded Trading Plus?
faqs.answer: Traders can request payouts on-demand once they have generated profits on their funded account. Payouts are processed via Rise, Bank Wire, or Cryptocurrency, typically within 24 hours of the request.

seo.title: Funded Trading Plus Payout Process Explained
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to request payouts at Funded Trading Plus. Discover the processing times, minimum payout amounts, and available withdrawal methods.

faqs.question: What is the profit split at Funded Trading Plus?
faqs.answer: Funded Trading Plus offers a starting profit split of 80% for the trader. This split can be scaled up to 90% as the trader demonstrates consistent profitability and scales their account.

seo.title: Funded Trading Plus Profit Split and Scaling
seo.metaDescription: Find out about the profit split options at Funded Trading Plus, starting at 80% and scaling up to 90% for successful traders.

faqs.question: How does the drawdown limit work?
faqs.answer: Funded Trading Plus utilizes daily and maximum drawdown limits depending on the selected program. The drawdown is calculated based on the account balance or equity, and breaching these limits will result in account closure.

seo.title: Understanding Drawdown Limits at Funded Trading Plus
seo.metaDescription: Get details on how daily and maximum drawdown limits are calculated at Funded Trading Plus to avoid account breaches.

faqs.question: Is the challenge fee refundable?
faqs.answer: Yes, the initial challenge fee is fully refunded to the trader along with their first successful profit withdrawal from the funded account.

seo.title: Funded Trading Plus Challenge Fee Refund Policy
seo.metaDescription: Learn about the refund policy for challenge fees at Funded Trading Plus, returned with your first payout.
